Name: SMALLBASE_MAP_VARIATION_PARAM_ST
Description: The maps (map pieces mAA_BB, AA = ID / 100) a site can use, with their enemy variations, modifiers and icons. SmallBaseAndSpotDefine rows list these IDs; pattern results place them on attach points.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 158 of 362 rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown Value
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 10 on most rows, 5 on encampments and ruins, 7 on Night Horde, 1 on castles and Great Hollow buildings, 0 on some boss maps.

Fields.Name: Map-Setup Draw Candidate
Fields.Description: Set: a placed site of this map joins a random draw made when the expedition's map is set up, together with the pattern's modifier-set 190 entry (retail modifiers 701-708). What the drawn site is used for is not established. Retail: set on the Night Horde maps and Sorcerer's Rise B.

Fields.Name: Invader Count
Fields.Description: Number of invaders (SmallbaseInvationNpcParam) placed at this site when it is chosen for invaders. Values above 2 count as 2. Retail: 2 on encampments, ruins and some Great Hollow buildings, 1 on 10 rows, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 1
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 1 (Variation ID 0) when the offline pattern lottery places this map. 0: the variation is never used. Retail 10 on every available variation. Not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 2
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 2 (Variation ID 1), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 3
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 3 (Variation ID 2), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 4
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 4 (Variation ID 3), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 5
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 5 (Variation ID 4), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 6
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 6 (Variation ID 5), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 7
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 7 (Variation ID 6), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 8
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 8 (Variation ID 7), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 9
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 9 (Variation ID 8), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Variation Value: 10
Fields.Description: Weight of variation 10 (Variation ID 9), as Variation Value 1.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier
Fields.Description: Offline lottery input: the map is only placed in patterns that have this modifier (e.g. 13 Rotted Woods, 180 on Night Horde maps, 603/604 on raid maps). 0: no requirement. Not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier
Fields.Description: Offline lottery input: the map is not placed in a pattern whose night 1 or night 2 boss has this modifier. Retail: night boss modifiers (400-449) on boss maps. 0: none. Not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Added Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier a placed copy of this map gives the pattern (copied into LotResultSmallBaseAndSpot Modifier, e.g. 424 on the Libra raid map). 0: none. Not read by the game itself.

Fields.Name: Variation Icon ID: 1
Fields.Description: World map icon shown on the site's pin when variation 1 (Variation ID 0) is placed. 0: none. Retail 42600-42610.

Fields.Name: Variation Icon ID: 2
Fields.Description: Pin icon for variation 2 (Variation ID 1), as Variation Icon ID 1.
